examples.evidence: KU-01/KU-02 preserve the SRT dipsick/re二 text while using burned captions to support DeepSeek/Ray2, and keep Luma as presenter-supplied identity rather than visually authenticated identity.
KU-09/KU-10/KU-14 distinguish the narrated workflow from the visible states and explicitly retain upload, submission, queue, completion and task binding as unshown.
CQ-10 is answered through DS-08/DS-09: five bounded playback regions record a constant low electronic instrumental bed and no confidently distinguishable UI or inserted-source effect change.
KU-17/KU-22 preserve the CTA relation and separate battle through about 25.500s, the 25.500-25.767s overlap, and the conservative 26.217s full-presenter anchor.
KU-06 through KU-08 cover the start image, empty end frame, visible prompt, Keyframe/Videos state, 5s, 1080p, Ray2 and Ray1.6 with resolvable frame/OCR evidence.
KU-10 and KU-14 cover every audited missing bridge and reject a task-level binding between the dragon/warrior configuration and later anime montage.
KU-11 through KU-13 preserve the three final sample groups, visible short-window continuity and the limits on universal no-distortion or physics claims.
KU-18 and KU-22 are supported by DS-08 through DS-10 and the repaired targeted frames.
The inference about the missing execution bridge includes explicit reasoning and before/during/after UI evidence.
The opening-to-closing relation is anchored to CUE-001/CUE-007 and is phrased as editorial structure, not product fact.
KU-18 says effects were not confidently heard in bounded listening; it does not assert universal absence, provenance or licence.
13.667-20.967s aligns with the audited Keyframe/input/parameter/Describe-state sequence.
20.967-25.500s retains the three audited result groups and no longer ends the battle montage at 25.267s.
TARGET-0075, TARGET-0132, TARGET-0134 and TARGET-0135 support battle at 25.500s, overlap at 25.600s, presenter-only after 25.767s, and full close-up at 26.217s.
Version/date, URL, platform/region, account/subscription, price/credits and generation time remain unknown.
Training data, sample provenance, post-processing, image/character rights, commercial licence and responsibility remain unknown.
The candidate does not infer task binding, raw server output duration/resolution/codec or universal no-distortion performance.
Listening supports a constant music bed while title, author, source, ownership and licence remain unknown.
